name: A Husband's Revenge
summary: In the Undercity, Raleigh Andrean sends you after the friend who murdered his wife.

sections.title: A Bitter Memory
sections.body: An engraved ring from Silverpine Forest brings Raleigh Andrean's mortal memories back to him. He remembers his close friend Valdred Moray, who murdered Raleigh's wife, Deliah. The Scourge's chill and undeath have dulled Raleigh's grief and love, but his thirst for revenge remains. You are sent to find Valdred.

sections.title: Justice at the Wall
sections.body: Valdred Moray fled south through Silverpine Forest, seeking refuge beyond the Greymane Wall. The gates to Gilneas stayed shut to refugees and outcasts. Trapped against the wall, Valdred met his end at Raleigh's command. His severed hands were carried back to the Undercity.

sections.title: Cold Keepsakes
sections.body: Raleigh receives his former friend's hands without warmth or relief. With the score settled, he returns Deliah's wedding band, calling it a useless bauble. Valdred Moray's severed hands remain in the Undercity as a lasting reminder of betrayal.

faq.q: Why does Raleigh want Valdred's hands specifically?
faq.answer: Raleigh wants Valdred's hands because they ended his wife's life. He keeps them in the Undercity as a trophy and reminder of his friend's betrayal.
Valdred Moray is in far southern Silverpine Forest, camped against the Greymane Wall after failing to enter Gilneas.

faq.q: Why does Raleigh give back the wedding ring?
faq.answer: Raleigh's attachment to Deliah has withered in undeath. Her ring means nothing to him; revenge was what mattered.
No. King Genn Greymane sealed Gilneas behind a wall after the Second War, and its gates remain closed. Valdred, like many desperate refugees, is stranded there.

faq.q: What quests lead up to this task?
faq.answer: The chain begins with The Engraved Ring in Silverpine Forest. It sends you to the Undercity in Raleigh and the Undercity, which opens A Husband's Revenge.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see how undeath has dulled Raleigh's love for his dead wife while leaving his hatred and hunger for revenge.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure the Undercity's borders by pursuing human outlaws through Silverpine Forest.
